<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>NSE IPO launch:</strong> The ₹22,562-crore NSE IPO opened for subscription with a muted start, seeing approximately 30-43% subscription on Day 1 as investors track valuation premiums and GMP signals.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxPRWFzb1poMXJad2l0dGEtY1VYelllUHBaa3g0dll2WXNSa2tCRFZwVW13blBlRjVlWnlQUG82Q1ZmT3hFRC00VFZ3RmJORS16aHhHWEtwRUVob1czbi03M1RmUWtYM1AyRzV2NVhaNnUyM0ZiaVJFNHVfRnNqNU9xaW42VXNBV3dPN2FsdWhWWXlSUTlTaFFCWWVic2hrWjlfSEFyR0VBYjdfRHZXUDRSckQzdFo1aC1nTWRhSENTMkNBZUllWXd1RA?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I34</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market performance:</strong> Indian indices traded flat as gains in select sectors were offset by concerns over rising bond yields and the rupee’s depreciation past the 96 mark against the US dollar.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I56</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I70</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Fed rate hike impact:</strong> The US Federal Reserve’s 25 bps rate hike—its first in three years—has pressured global sentiment and sparked debate over whether the RBI will follow with policy tightening in its October meeting.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W30</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W31</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Currency and liquidity:</strong> The rupee faced significant pressure, testing the 96 level against the dollar, prompting RBI intervention through dollar sales to stabilize the currency.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE96UC01UEs0QlMxVm4tRjVOYUExQnFKYWNiNnlWeGt4QkJJdkQ4QUNkbjE1cGVDOFhQN1pXb2U0NXZfaUR2TGJJSk9SSGlnWTJscE9abjZGb0pUM1Ytd09HZUFpaVhPQ3U5NldvY2J0MTJKcGZPdzRUOVQwNzgwZU0?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W27</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W28</a></span></li>
